title: Extend and retire a cyclotron's classifier set without losing learned state
description: As a Papyrus site operator, I want one shared cyclotron whose classifier set follows the site's newsroom sections as they are created, renamed and disabled, so that a section change never costs the other classifiers' learned labels, rubrics and ML models. Out of scope: automatic Papyrus section sync (the application calls add_classifiers and retire_classifiers).

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Feature: Change the classifier set of an existing store
  Scenario: Add a classifier
    Given an open store with learned classifiers
    When add_classifiers adds a classifier with a seed rubric
    Then the new classifier decides unfitted and the others keep labels and rubrics
  Scenario: Retire a classifier
    Given a store with several classifiers
    When retire_classifiers retires one
    Then it stops deciding and learning but its history and labels stay in the store
  Scenario: Reopen
    Given a changed classifier set
    When the store is reopened with the current definition
    Then it opens; a definition missing a recorded retirement or addition is refused
  Scenario: Re-add and idempotence
    Given a retired classifier
    When it is added again with the same spec
    Then it is reactivated with its prior history; repeating either call changes nothing

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Implemented add_classifiers and retire_classifiers with specs; make test green (2049 passed).
